messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Bethany Cole <bethany@brightpath.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Stage cleanup + final review — 'rogue' deals & commit readiness

Team —

Quick heads-up for this week's forecast submission: I want a short, targeted cleanup focused on deals that have drifted in stage for >30 days or have inconsistent close signals (what I'm calling "rogue" deals). Goal is to have final readiness signals and a clean commit list by EOD so finance gets a reliable submission.

Please do the following before the 11:00 pre-call:
- Update stage to the correct Sales Stage and add the two-line rationale in the notes (reason + next step).
- Tag any deal you believe is not commit-ready with the label "Rogue-Requalify" and add expected date for next milestone.
- Upload any missing procurement docs to the deal record (see template attached).

I've attached a lightweight template (stage-cleanup-template.xlsx) you can copy into each deal if you want a checklist. We'll run a 25-minute pre-call at 11:00 PT to triage the flagged deals and lock commit signals. If you cannot make the 11:00 slot, please update the record anyway and flag your account owner in the notes.

Agenda for 11:00 (quick):
- 3 min rules & scope
- 12 min triage: top 6 flagged deals (owner calls short)
- 7 min commit decisions / move to commit or disqualify
- 3 min action items & owners

Attachments: stage-cleanup-template.xlsx

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0123 | hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Sounds good — I'll run the scrub on my book this morning and flag any deals that need requalification. Notably, RD-3421 (BrightPath Analytics) shows a long pause at "Contract Review" with older procurement docs and no confirmed PO timeline. I've started a deal-log and will attach the export (deal-log.csv) to this thread with the top 10 at-risk items.

Quick note: for deals that we tag as "Rogue-Requalify", do we want a short suggested next step (e.g., "legal pre-call", "PO expected 2w") or keep notes entirely owner-driven? I can pre-fill suggestions if that helps speed the call.

-Karthik
